rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 20 AND 31, TITLE IV OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 957 REGULATING THE SALE OF SUBDIVISION LOTS, CONDOMINIUMS, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to ensure compliance by owners and developers of subdivision and condominium projects with their approved subdivision and/or condominium plans as well as the required facilities, infrastructures , improvements and other forms of development indicated in their brochures, prospectus and advertisements. It has been the practice of owner-developer s not to realize the development requirements indicated in the approved plans after they have disposed of all the lots and units in the subdivision and condominium projects. To protect the buyers, it is sought by this bill to PROHIBIT the disposition of any subdivision lots and the issuance of a building permit for the construction of the units in the subdivision or condominium projecct until all the necessary improvements and infrastructurea have been completed.

rows.author: A073
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE ABACA AS THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL FIBER
rows.abstract: Rationale: Philippine abaca is part of our history and cultural heritage.  It has sustained the domestic economy durng the struggle years of our country and eventually has helped make the Philippines known in the international market. It spotentialcontribution in the conservation of the forest resources cannot be underestimated. There is not other natural fiber in the world today that could come close to the superior and versatile qualities of the abaca, and it is with pride that we should recognize and uphold the importance of thus truly Filipino fiber.  It is, therefore, most fitting and appropriate to declare the abaca as the Philippine National Fiber.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE HEALTH SERVICE DELIVERY ENHANCEMENT PROGRAM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "health Service Delivery Enhancement Act of 2000." Rationale: Recently, the Department of Helath (DOH) has launched a health sector reform agenda that aims to reform the health sector to be incentive-motiv ated and performance-dri ven.  This will package the country's health resources in a way that ensures that each and every Filipino will have access to safe, quality and affordable health care products, facilities and services. > However, the Health Sector Reform Agenda needs support from thelegislature. We must help invest money on developing an incentive-motiv ated and performance-dri ven health care system that will produce maximum efficiency in the provision of quality health services. We must appropriate money that ensures maximum rreturn for our spending in terms of health benefits. when enacted, this bill will breathe life to this proposal.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2000-12-11

rows.author: C082
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE MONTHLY BENEFITS OF WORLD WAR II VETERANS, THEIR SPOUSES AND UNMARRIED MINOR CHILDREN
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to upgrade the monthly pension of living veterans and the surviving family of a deceased veteran. Besides increasing the amount of pension, this measure also integrates the old age and administrative disability pensions into one typeof monthly pension thereby increasing the amount due the veteran on a monthly basis. This bill provides for a different scheme in determining the rate of monthly pension because it is dependent on the age of the veteran at the time of the effectivity of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2000-12-11

rows.author: A041
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MAGNA CARTA FOR THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE
rows.abstract: "Magna Carta for the Philippine National Police."  This bill aims to effect reforms in the PNP organization by professionalizi ng it and ensuring that everyone in the PNP roster enjoys his/her basic rights and privileges throughout his/her entire career in the police service and upon retirement thereof.  The provisions provided in this bill uphold the basic rights of the police personnel including the right to equal opportunity in promotion and assignment by establishing an efficient merit system and promotion program, the right to receive continuing in-service quality education and training programs, the right of security of tenure and the right to present his complaints and grievance to his/her superior officer.  this proposed legislatioon primarily aims to address the inadequacies and flaws of the present PNP structure, organization and operation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 2000-12-11

rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING TAXES ON IDLE AGRICULTURAL, RESIDENTlAL AND INDUSTRIAL LANDS, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: This bill aims to curb the unjust and unproductive practice of monied individuals, partnerships and corporations of acquiring agricultural, residential and industrial lands for the sole purpose of speculating for profit motives on the future increase in the market value of such lands. > Said practice has resulted in the situation wherein vast tracts of land remain unutilized in the hands of a select few. Being a limited natural resource, these lands must be devoted to useful ends and with the broader objective of equitably distributing land to those who need it most.
